paragraphs.text: Weasel is a creature type for cards that depict a species of small mammals with long and slender bodies and short legs.

Weasel only appears on 2 cards: Brightblade Stoat and The Infamous Cruelclaw , which are mono- white and black-red , respectively. Consequently, they don't have a standard color in which they appear, though this may change in the future.
The creature type first appeared in Bloomburrow . They were originally intended to be the plane's black-red species, but Lizard s won out during development.
Ferret and Sable are both technically members of the weasel family, so it is possible that both could be errata'd to weasel, though there are currently no known plans for it.

Weasels or Weaselfolk are one of the animalfolk of Bloomburrow . Weaselfolk are less common than some of the animalfolk in the Valley . Perhaps the most well-known weaselfolk is the infamous mercenary and leader of Direshade Company, Cruelclaw .
Weasels serve as steeds for goblins in Eldraine .
